title: OrderCostSummaryEvent
description: An event about the break down of costs and taxes associated for an order in the partner's system.

order_reference_id.description: A unique, case-sensitive ID of the order in Canva's system. This must be the same value as the `orderReferenceId` path parameter.

handling_major_units.description:
The total cost (excluding tax) of the handling component of the cost item. This is value must be:

- In major units.
- In the currency provided.
- A numerical value. The currency symbol must be omitted.

pre_tax_total_major_units.description:
Total cost (excluding tax) of the order. This is value must be:

- In major units.
- In the currency provided.
- A numerical value. The currency symbol must be omitted.

tax_major_units.description:
Total tax of the order. This is value must be:

- In major units.
- In the currency provided.
- A numerical value. The currency symbol must be omitted.

post_tax_total_major_units.description:
Total cost (including tax) of the order. This is value must be:

- In major units.
- In the currency provided.
- A numerical value. The currency symbol must be omitted.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the values provided in the cost summary.

order_cost_items.description: A break down of the cost components included in the cost summary.

request_type.description: The type of request. Must be `cost_summary_event`.

order_cost_items.description: A break down of the cost components included in the cost summary.

OrderCostItem.description: A cost component of an item or shipment for an order.

item_reference_id.description: A unique, case-sensitive ID for an order item that the print partner can use when communicating with Canva. This is only provided when the `OrderCostItem` is a `product`, `add_on`, or `packaging`.

tracking_number.description: The tracking number provided by the carrier. This is only provided when the `OrderCostItem` is a `shipment`.

cost_major_units.description:
Total cost (excluding tax) of the cost item. This is value must be:

- In major units.
- In the currency provided.
- A numerical value. The currency symbol must be omitted.

tax_major_units.description:
Total tax of the cost item. This is value must be:

- In major units.
- In the currency provided.
- A numerical value. The currency symbol must be omitted.

total_major_units.description:
Total cost (including tax) of the cost item. This is value must be:

- In major units.
- In the currency provided.
- A numerical value. The currency symbol must be omitted.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the values provided in the cost summary.

type.description: The type of the cost item.

OrderCostItemType.description: The type of the cost item.
